violation_type.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)
violation_type.short_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps
violation_type.typical_finding: Multiple infants were observed in bucket chairs without the provided straps being used.

finding_variants.text: Multiple infants were observed in bucket chairs without the provided straps being used.
Three high chairs did not have straps.

Information obtained during a DFPS investigation shows that a caregiver failed to properly fasten the safety straps on a highchair as the safety straps were fastened, but not tightened resulting in an infant climbing out of the highchair and falling to the floor, hitting their head.
The safety strap on one of the high chairs in the infant room was missing the center fastener not allowing the straps to securely fasten.
Two children were observed not strapped in while sitting at a table eating that requires them to be strapped.
Three infants were observed seated at the lunch table without the required safety straps.     Note: This was corrected during the inspection.
